title: Extraction of RNA/DNA from Dried Blood on Filter Papers after Long-Term Storage
author: Gabriela Ulloa Urizar
materials: Put the 1.5 mL microtube in a ThermoMixer at 55°C for 00:30:00 at 2000 rpm. Spanish: Colocar el microtubo de 1.5 mL en un ThermoMixer a 55°C por 30 minutos a 2000 rpm.
Put the 1.5 mL microtube in a ThermoMixer at 37°C for at least 02:00:00 (120 minutes) at 2000 rpm. Spanish: Colocar el microtubo de 1.5 mL en un ThermoMixer a 37°C por al menos 2 horas a 2000 rpm.

steps.title: Cut blood circles
steps.instruction: Using a sterile punch, cut 10–12 circles of 3 mm diameter from the dried blood filter paper (≈50 µL blood per extraction).

steps.title: Add RLT Plus buffer
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL RLT Plus buffer to a 1.5 mL microtube containing the cut filter‑paper pieces, then spin 15 s at 10 000 rpm.

steps.title: Add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 65 µL proteinase K, vortex briefly, and spin 15 s at 10 000 rpm.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 3 min at 13 500 rpm.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to DNA column
steps.instruction: Carefully pipette ≈650 µL supernatant without touching the pellet, load onto an Allprep DNA column placed in a collection tube, close, and centrifuge 30 s at 10 000 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare DNA column with ethanol
steps.instruction: Place the DNA column in a new collection tube (reserve it). Recover the flow‑through, add an equal volume of 70 % ethanol (≈650 µL), and mix well by pipetting.

steps.title: Load ethanol‑lysate onto RNA column (first half)
steps.instruction: Transfer 650 µL of the ethanol‑mixed lysate to the RNA column in its collection tube and centrifuge 30 s at 10 000 rpm. Discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Load remaining lysate onto RNA column
steps.instruction: Add the remaining 650 µL of ethanol‑mixed lysate to the RNA column and centrifuge 30 s at 10 000 rpm. Discard the flow‑through. Keep the collection tube for subsequent washes.

steps.title: Wash RNA column with RW1
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL RW1 buffer to the RNA column, centrifuge 30 s at 12 000 rpm, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: First RPE wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL RPE buffer, centrifuge 30 s at 12 000 rpm, discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Second RPE wash
steps.instruction: Add another 500 µL RPE buffer, centrifuge 2 min at 12 000 rpm, discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry RNA membrane
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the RNA column 1 min at 13 500 rpm to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute RNA (first)
steps.instruction: Place the RNA column into a fresh 1.5 mL tube, add 30 µL RNase‑free water directly onto the membrane, wait 1 min, then centrifuge 1 min at 12 500 rpm.

steps.title: Elute RNA (second)
steps.instruction: Add another 30 µL RNase‑free water onto the membrane, wait 1 min, centrifuge 1 min at 12 500 rpm.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Discard the RNA column, label the tube, and store the eluate at –20 °C.

steps.title: Wash DNA column with AW1
steps.instruction: To the reserved DNA column, add 500 µL Buffer AW1, centrifuge 30 s at 12 500 rpm, discard flow‑through. Keep the collection tube for the next steps.

steps.title: Wash DNA column with AW2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW2, centrifuge 2 min at 12 500 rpm, discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry DNA membrane
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the DNA column 1 min at 13 500 rpm to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute DNA (first)
steps.instruction: Place the DNA column into a new 1.5 mL tube, add 50 µL Buffer EB onto the membrane, wait 1 min, centrifuge 1 min at 12 500 rpm.

steps.title: Elute DNA (second)
steps.instruction: Add another 50 µL Buffer EB onto the membrane, wait 1 min, centrifuge 1 min at 12 500 rpm.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Discard the DNA column, label the tube, and store the eluate at –20 °C.
